newsitem.title: USA: Flowers Inds to post Q1 non-operating gain.
newsitem.headline: Flowers Inds to post Q1 non-operating gain.

text.p: Flowers Industries Inc said on Friday it would post a non-operating gain in the first fiscal 1997 quarter, from the sale of about $66 million in notes.
The company said in a statement it expected to report about $0.35 for the quarter, which ends on September 21.
Flowers sold about $66 million in distributor notes receivable to Atlanta-based Sun Trust Bank, Chairman Amos McMullian said in a statement.

The branded food products company also said its current tax liability had increased after it decided to settle claims by the U.S. Internal Revenue Service that the notes constituted current rather than deferred income.
